# peakhour Provider

Interact with Peakhour CDN and edge security platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    peakhour = {
      source = "peakhour-io/peakhour"
    }
  }
}

provider "peakhour" {
  # The API key can also be set with the PEAKHOUR_API_KEY environment variable.
  api_key = "example-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Peakhour API key for authentication. May also be provided via PEAKHOUR_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Peakhour API base URL. Defaults to https://www.peakhour.io. May also be provided via PEAKHOUR_BASE_URL environment variable.
